question: May gateway JSON message/reason fields become locale-dependent display text, or should this PR keep those protocol-facing strings stable while localizing only presentation surfaces?
rationale: The branch localizes fields returned from gateway APIs as well as chat/runtime copy, and source review alone cannot decide whether downstream clients treat those string fields as display-only or stable protocol text.

options.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Require this PR to localize only presentation surfaces and leave gateway protocol-facing message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.

options.title: Accept Display-Only Strings
options.body: Allow localized gateway message/reason fields if maintainers confirm clients must use stable codes/types rather than English text.

options.title: Pause Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers define a runtime i18n boundary for chat, gateway, TUI, and plugin classifier surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Require this PR to localize only presentation surfaces and leave gateway protocol-facing message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.
